mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_message (msg_id, from_user, to_user, group_id, content, cmd, is_offline, create_time, message_type, extra) VALUES (#{msgId}, #{fromUser}, #{toUser}, #{groupId}, #{content}, #{cmd}, #{isOffline}, NOW(), #{messageType}, #{audioUrl})
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT u.user_id AS userId, u.username AS userName FROM chat_user u WHERE u.user_id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN from_user = #{userId} THEN to_user ELSE from_user END FROM chat_message WHERE (from_user = #{userId} OR to_user = #{userId}) AND cmd = 2 );

SELECT from_user AS fromUser, to_user AS toUser, content, create_time AS createTime, message_type as messageType, extra as audioUrl FROM chat_message WHERE ((from_user = #{userId} AND to_user = #{peerId}) OR (from_user = #{peerId} AND to_user = #{userId})) AND cmd = 2 ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT from_user AS fromUser, to_user AS toUser, content, create_time AS createTime, message_type as messageType, extra as audioUrl FROM chat_message WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND cmd = 3 ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT msg_id AS msgId, from_user AS fromUser, to_user AS toUser, content, cmd, is_read AS isRead, is_offline AS isOffline, create_time AS createTime, message_type as messageType, extra as audioUrl FROM chat_message WHERE ((from_user = #{userId} AND to_user = #{peerId}) OR (from_user = #{peerId} AND to_user = #{userId})) AND cmd = 2 ORDER BY create_time DESC
